source.reference: IAEA-NDS INDC(NDS)-0785, Kos and Kodeli, May 2019, DOI 10.61092/iaea.ny5x-0pq9; OECD-NEA SINBAD TIARA 43/68 MeV benchmark, Tables 1 and 4, https://www.oecd-nea.org/science/wprs/shielding/sinbad/tiara/tia-abs.htm

files.role: measured TIARA BC501A on-axis neutron yield table

normalisation.quantity: BC501A detector-volume neutron flux per proton beam charge, per unit lethargy
normalisation.units: neutrons cm-2 microC-1 per unit lethargy
normalisation.source_normalisation: source spectrum shape from the 68 MeV TIARA/SINBAD source spectrum (JADE SI1 H/SP1 cards); the MCNP tally multiplier FM14=1.31126E+11 is preserved exactly and corresponds to PtC 2.61 x peak flux 4.00E+9 n sr-1 microC-1 x 4*pi using the printed rounded factor 3.14
normalisation.location: F4 volume flux tally in the 12.7 cm diameter by 12.7 cm long BC501A scintillator, MCNP cell 109, on axis just behind the shield
normalisation.reaction_or_particle: neutron fluence spectrum (not detector pulse-height response); BC501A modeled as liquid scintillator in the input
normalisation.energy_integration: MCNP E14 upper boundaries; each tally integral is divided by ln(E_hi/E_lo) to obtain per-unit-lethargy response; the 0-to-6 MeV first interval is blocked because its lower edge is zero
normalisation.basis: The pinned MCNP input defines F14:n 109, FM14 and E14. Kos and Kodeli (IAEA INDC(NDS)-0785, section 2.2.2-2.2.3) state that the source energy spectrum is taken from SINBAD Table 4 with source bin boundaries interpreted as upper boundaries, the source is at the origin, the BC501A volume is 12.7 cm x 12.7 cm and tally F4 is normalized with PtC*PF*4*pi. The OECD-NEA SINBAD TIARA 43/68 MeV page says transmitted spectra are normalized per proton beam charge using the source peak flux and source spectrum. The exact FM card is used; the source card's SB sampling bias is not folded into the physical source distribution.

components.name: JADE experimental Error and abs err columns
components.meaning: The CSV's Error column is the reported relative error and abs err is the absolute uncertainty column. The source materials do not identify the confidence level or covariance structure; no confidence interpretation is added.

uncertainty.note: Retains each published abs err as u. The measurement confidence meaning and inter-bin covariance are unknown; compatibility therefore uses covariance unknown and remains INCONCLUSIVE until that uncertainty structure is resolved.

compatibility.k_basis: Authored coverage factor 2 for comparison only; the experimental uncertainty confidence meaning is unspecified, so this rule cannot establish PASS/FAIL.

covariance.basis: The source reports bin uncertainties but no covariance; source normalization and unfolding can correlate energy bins.

neutron_spectrum_in_detector.unit: neutrons cm-2 microC-1 per unit lethargy
neutron_spectrum_in_detector.description: measured on-axis BC501A volume neutron spectrum immediately behind the named TIARA iron or concrete shield; not a general transport flux validation

materials: iron collimator, iron/polyethylene shutter, concrete building, aluminium support and BC501A scintillator as defined in the pinned input
qualified_range.geometry_class: full TIARA beamline, collimator, shield and BC501A detector CSG from JADE MCNP input translated to OpenMC; on-axis detector
qualified_range.spectrum_class: 68 MeV proton on 99.9% Li-7 target; measured quasi-monoenergetic source spectrum prescribed as MCNP SI1 H/SP1 histogram; physical angular distribution from SP2; MCNP SB2 bias omitted

translation.geometry: directly translated from the pinned MCNP cell/surface cards; see run_case.py strict supported-card set
translation.source: SI1 H/SP1 normalized histogram; SP2 checked against isotropic cosine probability; SB2 is omitted as a sampling bias
translation.scoring: Cell 109 flux energy tally with FM14 scale and lethargy normalization
translation.nuclear_data_preflight: all required nuclide tables must cover the 72.5 MeV maximum source energy; incomplete upper-energy evaluations block scoring and no extrapolation is applied
